name: Estonia — Estonian parties
intro: compare it with Estonian political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Estonia: those represented in the parliament (Riigikogu) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Riigikogu) after the 2023 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 101 members. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

SDE.name: Sotsiaaldemokraatlik Erakond
SDE.priorities: Welfare state, Education, Defence and support for Ukraine
SDE.description: Social Democratic Party, pro-European and strongly pro-Ukraine.

Kesk.name: Eesti Keskerakond
Kesk.priorities: Welfare state, Pensions and the elderly, Rights of the national minority
Kesk.description: Centre Party, long popular with Estonia's Russian-speaking minority, favouring progressive taxes and social spending.

Volt.name: Volt Estonia
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

E200.name: Eesti 200
E200.priorities: Education, Digital innovation, Deeper European integration
E200.description: Liberal party that entered parliament in 2023 and joined the government.

Reform.name: Eesti Reformierakond
Reform.priorities: Defence and support for Ukraine, Fiscal discipline, Digital innovation
Reform.description: Liberal Reform Party, which leads the government; free-market, digital-state and hawkish on Russia.

Isamaa.name: Isamaa
Isamaa.priorities: Defence and support for Ukraine, National language and culture, Traditional family values
Isamaa.description: National-conservative Fatherland party, which led the polls in 2025 on defence, Estonian identity and tax criticism.

Parempoolsed.name: Erakond Parempoolsed
Parempoolsed.priorities: Fiscal discipline, Lower taxes, Rule of law
Parempoolsed.description: The Right-wingers, a liberal-conservative party formed by former Isamaa members.

EKRE.name: Eesti Konservatiivne Rahvaerakond
EKRE.priorities: National identity, Reducing immigration, National sovereignty
EKRE.description: Conservative People's Party, nationalist and Eurosceptic but firmly anti-Russian.
